question: What is the percentage of the set of cards that have Chinese Simplified as the language and are only available for online games?
evidence: are only available for online games refers to isOnlineOnly = 1; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(isOnlineOnly = 1),COUNT(isOnlineOnly))*100
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
gold: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' AND T1.isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode
gold0: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' AND T1.isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM sets AS T1 INNER JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode

b.request: Percentage of all sets (including sets with no set_translations record, via a left join) whose Chinese Simplified translation exists and whose isOnlineOnly = 1, relative to the total count of sets.
b.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.language = 'Chinese Simplified' AND T1.isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.id) FROM sets AS T1 LEFT JOIN set_translations AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.setCode

c.request:
What is the percentage of the set of cards that have Chinese Simplified as the language and are only available for online games?
Evidence: are only available for online games refers to isOnlineOnly = 1; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(isOnlineOnly = 1),COUNT(isOnlineOnly))*100
Also keep rows that have no matching set_translations record.
c.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN st.language = 'Chinese Simplified' AND s.isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode

d.request: What is the percentage of sets that have Chinese Simplified as the language and are only available for online games (isOnlineOnly = 1), calculated as COUNT(isOnlineOnly = 1) divided by COUNT(isOnlineOnly) times 100, while also keeping sets that have no matching set_translations record?
d.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.isOnlineOnly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(s.id) FROM sets s LEFT JOIN set_translations st ON s.code = st.setCode AND st.language = 'Chinese Simplified'
